name: Example Page Tools
description: 用于测试页面工具订阅、匹配和执行的示例工具集

tools.name: get_page_summary
tools.description: 读取当前标签页的标题、URL 和页面文本摘要

maxLength.description: 返回正文摘要的最大字符数

tools.execute: async ({ maxLength = 300 } = {}) => ({ title: document.title, url: location.href, summary: document.body?.innerText?.trim().slice(0, maxLength) || '' })

tools.name: highlight_text
tools.description: 在当前页面高亮匹配的文本
tools.execute: async ({ text, color = 'yellow' } = {}) => { if (!text) throw new Error('text is required'); const walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let count = 0; const nodes = []; while (walker.nextNode()) { const node = walker.currentNode; if (node.nodeValue.includes(text)) nodes.push(node); } for (const node of nodes) { const parts = node.nodeValue.split(text); const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment(); parts.forEach((part, index) => { if (part) fragment.append(part); if (index < parts.length - 1) { const mark = document.createElement('mark'); mark.textContent = text; mark.style.background = color; fragment.append(mark); count++; } }); node.parentNode.replaceChild(fragment, node); } return { count }; }

tools.name: fill_input
tools.description: 根据 CSS selector 给输入框赋值并触发 input/change 事件
tools.execute: async ({ selector, value } = {}) => { if (!selector) throw new Error('selector is required'); const el = document.querySelector(selector); if (!el) throw new Error(`No element found: ${selector}`); el.focus?.(); el.value = value ?? ''; el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { bubbles: true, inputType: 'insertText', data: String(value ?? '') })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return { selector, value: el.value }; }
